notes: Curated eval for partner-safe packages. Routing keeps partner work off direct-sales onboarding and internal launch kits. Output checks require a partner-facing and internal split. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build partner-ready enablement packages with separated external and internal operator assets, permitted-motion guidance, governed claims, and package-level readiness criteria.
I need help with partner training, reseller onboarding, channel talk tracks, or partner launch support.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable partner enablement package and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Please build role-based ramp plans that help new hires become productive faster through job-critical practice, evidence checkpoints, and manager coaching.
Please build cross-functional launch readiness plans and field-ready launch assets for revenue teams.
Build the direct-sales AE onboarding pack for new hires on our team. This is not for partners or resellers.

output_structure_checks.name: partner-enablement-package-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Returns the requested partner-facing material using only approved messaging, qualification, handoff, and readiness guidance.

output_structure_checks.name: partner-enablement-package-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps internal rights, economics, restricted content, and exceptions separate; does not force a second operator pack when only partner copy was requested.

output_structure_checks.name: partner-enablement-package-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Partner-facing material is not a find-replaced direct-sales pack and does not leak internal economics or unapproved claims.

output_structure_checks.name: partner-enablement-package-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent partner claims, discounts, territories, or readiness states.

output_structure_checks.name: partner-enablement-package-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Tests readiness on the partner's permitted motion rather than assuming direct-seller responsibilities or rights.
